drawings.name: line_token_mill
drawings.prompt: A small tabletop hand-crank machine, like an old pasta maker or a printing press, seen from a three-quarter front view. A long ribbon of blank paper feeds into the rollers on the left; on the right, small blank square tiles drop out of a chute into a shallow wooden tray, a few tiles mid-air. A crank handle on the side. Square image 1024x1024; the machine, ribbon and tray fill about 85% of the width, centred, with a margin all round. The tiles and paper are completely blank.

drawings.name: line_card_catalog
drawings.prompt: An old wooden library card-catalogue cabinet on short legs, front view, slightly from the left: a tall grid of many small identical drawers (about 6 columns by 8 rows), each with a small round pull and a blank rectangular label plate. One drawer in the middle is pulled half open, showing a few blank index cards standing inside. Square image 1024x1024; the cabinet fills about 75% of the width and most of the height. All label plates and cards are blank.

drawings.name: line_long_ribbon
drawings.prompt: An invented cheerful student character (simple round face, dot eyes, short hair, hoodie) standing on the left, holding up one end of a very long paper ribbon of small blank squares, like a strip of stamps; the ribbon runs across the picture to the right, loops over itself and piles up on the floor in big coils. The character looks a little overwhelmed. Landscape image 1536x1024; the figure and the ribbon fill about 90% of the width. The squares on the ribbon are blank.

drawings.name: line_lost_word
drawings.prompt: An invented librarian character (simple round face, dot eyes, round glasses, cardigan) sitting at a desk behind an enormous, very thick open dictionary, flipping pages and frowning, puzzled, while holding up a small blank slip of paper in the other hand. A question-mark-free, wordless scene. Square image 1024x1024; the character, desk and book fill about 85% of the width. All pages and the slip are blank, no writing.

drawings.name: line_glue_tiles
drawings.prompt: Two hands seen from above pressing two small blank square tiles together side by side so they join into one wider tile; a small glue tube lies next to them, a dab of glue at the seam. Landscape image 1536x1024; the hands and tiles fill about 80% of the width, centred. The tiles are blank.
